criterion: Error messages: specific, actionable / misleading UI
description: On an agent-only client, a valid fresh grant is refused (bootstrap 403 FORBIDDEN) but the browser says "The sign-in link was already used or has expired. Links from your agent work once." and advises running `pardner client open`, which fails on this device.
expected: "This computer joined a project as an agent, so it can't open the board in a browser. Open Pardner on your own computer, or link this computer with a My device invitation."
actual: Expired-link notice and agent advice; Check again removes the notice; dead end.
suggested_fix: Distinguish FORBIDDEN from AUTH_REQUIRED in the bootstrap failure handling and render an agent-only message.

description: `pardner open` on an agent-only client fails with only `FORBIDDEN: Human authority required`.
expected: A message naming the cause (joined through an Agent invitation) and the alternatives.
actual: Internal jargon ("human authority") with no next step.
suggested_fix: Reword the /open refusal for the agent-only case and add a hint.
